info.description: Content for the public marketing homepage (/): hero, feature grid, how-it-works walkthrough, audience segments, and the closing CTA. Publicly readable (find only, auth: false) - see routes/homepage.ts and bootstrap/permissions-setup.ts's PUBLIC_PERMISSIONS. Pricing content lives on the separate solution-page singleType (its own /solution route); the header/footer logo lives on global-settings (shown on every page, not just this one).

heroTitleBefore.description: Text before the highlighted phrase in the hero <h1>.

heroHighlight.description: The colored/highlighted phrase, rendered as its own <span>.

heroTitleAfter.description: Text after the highlighted phrase. These 3 fields are concatenated in the template instead of splitting a single title string on the highlight substring, which would silently drop text if an edit ever broke the substring match.
